text:
**Best all-around kit: [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).** Its 2,073.6Wh capacity is a useful fit for van life: the cited guide estimates it can run a 12V fridge and charge a laptop for three days or more. The kit is listed at $1,199, with a code mentioned on the [product guide](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-van-life).

One caveat: its car socket is listed at just 96W, so it’ll recharge slowly while driving. If you’re mainly looking for a lighter power station rather than a bundle, the [Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/) is a strong van-oriented alternative: 24.9 lb, 1,024Wh capacity, and up to 600W solar input.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
products: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The top pick is our BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kit, with price, capacity and the 96 W car-socket caveat taken from dealectric.com, while the Anker alternative cites powersized.com.
